top_signals.title: UAE Energy Contractor NMDC Plans December Acquisition, CEO Says
top_signals.summary: Energy and marine services company NMDC Group PJSC aims to announce an acquisition next month as the Middle Eastern company looks to boost growth after the war caused a slump in its regional business, said Chief Executive Officer Yasser Zaghloul.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
